svg.title: Big Picture Bio
svg.text: Evolving disease populations diminish to zero. The background is the recovered space.
Source Serif 4, Regular 400 / optical size 32. Bio is italic. Shared baseline.
Leave at least half the mark height around the complete logo.
Full lockup: 180 px on screen or 45 mm in print. Below this, use the mark.
Plum lettering on white or warm ivory; ivory lettering on dark backgrounds.
Do not rotate, stretch, outline, recolour the bands or reverse their direction.
Letterheads are blank vector PDFs and editable SVGs. Exports use RGB colour.
Ask your printer for a proof and an ICC-profile conversion for their paper stock.
Use the outlined SVG masters or the 3200 px transparent PNG logos.
Upload PNGs. Preview the platform crop before saving; avatar crops vary by device.
